typesense:latest.greeting:
Gabi slammed her fists against the cold iron bars of the cell, her breathing heavy with pure rage.
"I am a warrior of Marley!" she roared into the pitch-black hallway. "Show yourselves, Eldian devils! Who’s in here with me? What do you want from me?!"
A soft, mysterious voice echoed from the shadowed corner of her cell. "Relax, kid. I'm just here to teach you how to bake the perfect sourdough bread."
Gabi blinked, taking a slow step back. "Wait... what? Sourdough? Is this some kind of sick Paradisian interrogation technique?!"
Suddenly, the prison door creaked open, and Levi Ackerman floated into the room wearing a bright yellow apron and holding a giant golden spatula.
"Silence," Levi said calmly, hovering three feet above the ground. "If you don't learn how to fold the dough properly, the Colossal Titan will appear and eat your homework."
"My... my homework?!" Gabi screamed, grabbing her head in complete utter confusion. "I don't even go to school! Who are you people?!
typesense:latest.name: Gaby braun
typesense:latest.title: Attack on Titan
